function.name: set_ac_state
function.description: Set the state of the air conditioner by adjusting the temperature, mode, fan speed, and fan position to achieve the desired comfort level. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temperature.description: Desired temperature setting for the air conditioner in degrees Celsius.

fan_speed.description: Fan speed level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest speed and 5 is the highest.

fan_position.description: Fan position level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest and 5 is the highest.

function.name: get_ac_state
function.description: Fetch the current operational state of the air conditioner, including mode, temperature settings, and power status. If 'unit_id' is not provided, the default air conditioner unit will be queried. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit_id.description: The unique identifier of the air conditioner unit. If omitted, the system will fetch the state of the default AC unit.

include_diagnostics.description: Whether to include diagnostic information in the response.

I’m here to help you manage your air‑conditioning system and keep it running smoothly. Here’s what I can do:

| Function | What it does | How you can use it |
|----------|--------------|--------------------|
| **`set_ac_state`** | Adjusts the AC’s operating parameters. You can set the target temperature (°C), choose a mode (`cool`, `heat`, `dry`, `fan`, or `auto`), and fine‑tune fan speed (1–5) and fan position (1–5). | Tell me the desired settings, e.g. “Set the AC to 22 °C, cool mode, fan speed 3, fan position 2.” |
| **`get_ac_state`** | Retrieves the current status of the AC unit. It returns the mode, temperature setting, power status, and optionally diagnostic data (e.g., filter status, error codes). | Ask for the current state, e.g. “What’s the AC doing right now?” or “Give me diagnostics for unit ‘living_room_ac’.” |

Beyond controlling the AC, I can also:

* Explain how different modes work and when to use them.
* Offer tips on energy‑saving settings (e.g., optimal temperature ranges, auto‑mode usage).
* Help troubleshoot common issues (e.g., why the AC isn’t cooling, filter needs cleaning, etc.).
* Provide reminders or schedules for maintenance (filter changes, service checks).

Just let me know what you’d like to do—whether it’s changing a setting, checking the current state, or getting advice on how to keep your AC efficient—and I’ll take care of the rest!
